excerpt.zh: 在最近的一场降雨中，殖民者注意到了[Root.GetName]的表面出现了一些金属泥潭。这些泥潭具有很大的黏度，如同液态金属一般。
excerpt.en: After a recent rainfall, colonists have noticed metallic puddles appearing on the surface of [Root.GetName]. These puddles have a viscous consistency, like liquid metal.

texts.zh: 在最近的一场降雨中，殖民者注意到了[Root.GetName]的表面出现了一些金属泥潭。这些泥潭具有很大的黏度，如同液态金属一般。
texts.en: After a recent rainfall, colonists have noticed metallic puddles appearing on the surface of [Root.GetName]. These puddles have a viscous consistency, like liquid metal.

label.zh: 禁止接触泥潭。可能有毒！
label.en: Leave them alone. They may be toxic!

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的这些黏性金属泥潭正在扩张。陆地上巨大的条带被银色的黏液覆盖。他们似乎在暴雨之后开始增殖了。
texts.en: The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] are growing. Huge swathes of land are now covered in silver slime. They seem to grow following heavy rainfall.

texts.zh: 消失了！[Root.GetName]上的那些金属泥潭在一夜之间消失得一干二净，没有留下半点痕迹。我们不知道它们还会不会再出现……
texts.en: They're gone! The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] have disappeared. It's as if they've just evaporated. We don't know if or when they'll be back again...

label.zh: 有时候事情会自己解决自己。
label.en: Sometimes these things just resolve themselves...

texts.zh: 回来了！在[Root.GetName]上的黏性金属泥潭又回来了。他们仍在躲避[Root.GetName]上的殖民者们对其本质的探察。我们获得了第二次机会，抓住这次机会好好研究。
texts.en: They're back! The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] have returned. Their nature continues to elude the colonists on [Root.GetName]. We've been handed another opportunity. We should investigate them while we can.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的这些黏性金属泥潭在躲避着殖民地科学家。目前其根源仍未探明，并且还一直在抗拒我们的探察。我们的仪器正在费劲地解码它们的化学组成。如果想要获得答案我们还有许多测试要做。
texts.en: The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] are eluding colony scientists. So far their origin is undetermined, and they have been resistant to our probing. Our instruments are struggling to decipher their chemical makeup. We have more tests to run if we want answers.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上发现了一种新的单质！以黏性金属泥潭为契机，我们获得了一个突破性的发现，这些泥潭是由一种单一的金属单质构成的。这种元素目前被我们命名为[Root.GetName]钖，存在于[Root.GetName]的大气中，但当混入大量降雨中时就会呈现出在行星表面发现的那种黏性。其存在形式呈现循环性，与基于一氧化二氢构成的泥潭相似。

真是个绝妙的发现。我们对元素的认知拓展了。
texts.en:
A new element has been discovered on [Root.GetName]! After a breakthrough in the case of the viscous metallic puddles, we have discovered the puddles comprise a unique chemical element. The element, which we're calling [Root.GetName]onium, is present in the air on [Root.GetName], but when introduced to high precipitation, takes on the viscous consistency we have seen on the planet's surface. Their appearances are cyclical, much like dihydrogen-monoxide based puddles.

A fascinating discovery. Our understanding of the elements continues to grow.

label.zh: 我们还有许多要学习的。
label.en: We still have much to learn.

texts.zh: 对[Root.GetName]神奇的气象学进行深入研究对我们的科学发展的帮助无可估量。
texts.en: Research into [Root.GetName]'s fascinating meteorology could prove invaluable to our scientific development.

texts.zh: 我们已经获得了对[Root.GetName]独特天气系统的意义非凡的洞见。在拓展了我们对化学元素的理解以外，我们最近的研究还对我们的食物生产带来了积极的影响。
texts.en: We have gained invaluable insight into the unique weather systems of [Root.GetName]. In addition to expanding our understanding of chemical elements, our recent research has had positive implications for food production.
